title: BarrelSpell
description: This is an addon that adds defense and CreateBigCannon content for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks.
body:
This is an addon for Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks(Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - Minecraft Mod) that adds: deflecting projectiles, limiting incoming damage, a defense that uses mana to block damage before health, and instant-kill attacks. When Create Big Cannon is installed, it provides spells for summoning AP and HE, as well as creeping barrage and suppression barrage spells.

这是一个附属 为 铁的魔法 Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks (Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks - Minecraft Mod)增加
偏折弹射物 限制受到的伤害 用mana在生命之前抵挡伤害的防御 以及直接致死的攻击内容
在安装有CreateBigCannon时 提供召唤AP和HE以及徐进弹幕和压制弹幕的法术
